title: ALMA full polarization observations of PKS 1830-211 during its record-breaking flare of 2019
question: How do the polarization properties of the lensed blazar PKS 1830-211 differ between its two lensed images and vary on intra-hour timescales during its 2019 gamma-ray flare, and can differential polarimetry be validated with full-polarization data?

recipe.method: Standard calibration, flagging of absorption lines, polarization calibration with J1924-2914, phase-only self-cal on Stokes I
key_parameters: self-cal solint 6 s, all spws combined

recipe.goal: Image Stokes I,Q,U and derive m and EVPA
recipe.method: tclean per Stokes, immath pixel-wise m and phi
Each ~410 s scan split in three segments; Stokes I, Q, U of both images fitted independently with uvmultifit; differential NE/SW approach
assumptions: Both lensed images point-like within the beam

recipe.method: Fit XX and YY flux ratios in 15 segments per scan, compute Rpol=(rho_X/rho_Y-1)/2 vs source rotation, compare with prediction from full-pol Stokes parameters
key_parameters: feed rotation beta = 45 deg in Band 6

recipe.goal: Faraday rotation fit of differential EVPA
recipe.method: Thin Faraday screen (phi ∝ lambda^2) fit to NE-SW EVPA difference at each time bin

evidence.quote: a fractional polarization peak of 14% (in the SW image, with a flux density of 2.34 Jy)
5.4% (in the NE image, with a flux density of 2.10 Jy)
its EVPA ($-24$ degrees) is rotated $\sim$15 degrees with respect to that of the SW
a clear linear increase in the EVPA difference between the two images (see Fig. [2](#fig:curves)A) at a rate of about two degrees per hour
we estimate a variation from $\Delta\alpha \sim -0.19$ to $\Delta\alpha \sim -0.05$ between the start and end of the observations

answer_key.quantity: Weighted mean RM of differential NE-SW

evidence.quote: The weighted average of all the RM measurements is $(3.4 \pm 1.7)\times 10^4$ rad m$^{-2}$.
The maximum $R_{pol}$ measured in our 2019 observations ($\sim 0.1$; Fig. [4](#fig:diffpol))

not_stated_but_needed: tclean cell size, image size, iteration/threshold and mask definition
line-free channel selection and flagged absorption/atmospheric ranges
uvmultifit source-model settings and error estimation
fit method for Faraday RM and the NE/SW flux ratio function
score_reason: Short letter; steps described qualitatively with many imaging/fit parameters missing, though data are a single public project.
rediscovery_reason: Public single-project data, simple recipe, numeric results (polarization fractions, EVPA rate).
